answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 20551 Country: LK Title: Is performing salaah valid when someone pray while his/her hair colored with black hair dye? Question: Is performing salaah valid when someone pray while his/her hair colored with black hair dye? salaam. Answer ID: 20551 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 482/402/B=1431) Colouring hair with black dye is makrooh tahrimi and performing salah in this condition would be makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
